Alhamdullillah I try to do one para daur daily (in about an hour) and try to finish it again in my salaah. To learn the daur I first read the first 2 pages from the Quraan then I recite it by heart, I continue like this till I have completed the whole para. Then if my mind does not feel too tired, I read the whole para again from memory, thereafter I do my sabak daur. answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 59669 Country: India Title: Holy Quran & Non-Muslim Question: Is it right to given Holy Quran to non-Muslim as he demanded because today it came my knowledge that it is wrong to given Holy Quran to non-Muslim. Please guide me. Answer ID: 59669 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 917/913/B=09/1436) If he requests someone for Quran to recite it then you may give it with the condition that he would take a bath, wear clean clothes and sit on a neat and clean place and recite the holy Quran. If he agrees then you may give him the holy Quran hoping for his guidance and there is no harm in it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
